# v0.9.22

## 中文

### 更新内容

- 设置中的更新渠道现可选择“自动”“GitCode（AtomGit）”或“GitHub”。自动模式优先使用 GitCode，连接失败时回退 GitHub。
- 自动模式会核对 GitCode 与 GitHub 的最新版本。两端版本尚未同步一致时，暂缓下载安装，并可稍后刷新状态。
- 下载安装包前会核对对应版本的 SHA-256 校验信息；更新窗口会显示实际使用的渠道。
- GitCode Release 的版本说明同步 GitHub Release 的中英文内容，发布流程也会同步代码分支与标签。

## English

### What's new

- Added “Automatic,” “GitCode (AtomGit),” and “GitHub” update channels in Settings. Automatic prefers GitCode and falls back to GitHub when GitCode cannot be reached.
- Automatic checks that the latest GitCode and GitHub versions match. Downloads wait until the two channels have the same version; users can refresh the status later.
- Installer downloads verify the SHA-256 information for the selected release, and the update dialog shows the channel in use.
- GitCode Releases now mirror the bilingual GitHub release notes, while the publishing workflow also synchronizes code branches and tags.
